node.title: Re: Handling utf-8 characters when scraping
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Assuming that your source file is encoded correctly in UTF-8, then the output you've shown is correct - \x{2026} is [https://unicode.org/cldr/utility/character.jsp?a=2026|U+2026 HORIZONTAL ELLIPSIS]. Could you show an [id://1177642|SSCCE] of code you're having trouble with?
